title: Combat feel: Perfect Dodge and the last blow
items: Perfect Dodge: roll through an attack at the last instant and the Rot slows to a crawl around you. Strike while your blade burns for a guaranteed critical Riposte (+50% damage), with stamina and Charge refunded.
The last abomination of a fight now falls in slow motion with a deep toll, a lens punch-in and a red shockwave. Felling the Bellwright gets a longer, heavier moment.
Heavy strikes have real weight: the Warden sinks and draws back as the synth edge charges and flares, then throws the whole body into the cut.
Abominations flinch, twist and buckle when your blade lands, so every hit reads.
Snappier controls: dodge out of any wind-up (half the stamina back) or straight out of a finished swing. The blade trail now only streaks during the actual cut.

title: The first night in the Ninth Ward
items: WARDEN replaces Ebbmarrow as the main game. Ebbmarrow stays playable at /arcade/.
Name your Warden and pass your first judgment. Your verdict gives you a trait: Dread, Measure or Inquest.
Third-person synthblade combat: three-hit light combo, heavy strikes, dodge rolls, lock-on, hitstop and blade trails.
Hallowmere's Ninth Ward: Lantern Street, Statute Plaza, Cutpurse Alley and the Grave Gate, in endless rain and fog.
Abominations of the Rot: Hollowed Husks, Skitters, Bile Spitters and the Bellwright.
Gear in five rarity tiers (Issued, Forged, Tempered, Relic, Sovereign). Temper it at the Forge with scrap.
Cores: slot chips into gear for new effects. Every Core raises the item a rarity tier.
Three skill branches (Blade, Bulwark, Circuit) with 15 perks, including the Overload shock nova.
Progress saves automatically in your browser.
